services.name: Patient Records API
services.description: CRUD operations for patient demographics, medical history, and PHI-encrypted records.

services.name: Appointments API
services.description: Manages appointment scheduling, availability, and provider calendar integration.

services.name: Notification Service API
services.description: Sends HIPAA-compliant appointment reminders via SMS and email. No PHI in message bodies.

endpoints.description: Retrieve patient record with PHI fields decrypted for authorized callers.
Update patient record. Requires version header for optimistic locking.
Retrieve PHI access audit trail for a specific patient.
Create a new appointment. Triggers sync to patient records service.
List available appointment slots for a provider on a given date range.
Queue an appointment reminder. Message body contains only appointment time and location, no PHI.
